scope: Title, venue, year and first-party publication-provenance checks only; not full-paper review, experiment reproduction, a semantic classification review or expanded admission rules.
source_policy: Existing hand-verified seeds override discovered duplicates. A preprint bibliographic entry is not used as the sole evidence of conference acceptance when verified formal proceedings are available.

conference_additions.title: Demonstrating Event-Triggered Investigation and Sample Collection for Human Scientists using Field Robots and Large Foundation Models

primary_evidence.verified_claim: The official RSS XX proceedings give the same title and list it in Proceedings of Robotics: Science and Systems, July 2024, with DOI 10.15607/RSS.2024.XX.017.

conference_additions.reason: The paper is a newly admitted 2024 conference record, not a newly published October 2026 paper. Its title beginning with Demonstrating does not determine the acceptance tier; the formal proceedings do. The truncated Semantic Scholar abstract is retained as observed rather than completed by inference.

provenance_corrections.title: HiMaCon: Discovering Hierarchical Manipulation Concepts from Unlabeled Multi-Modal Data

primary_evidence.verified_claim: The official NeurIPS proceedings identify the title and authors in Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38 Main Conference (NeurIPS 2025), Main Conference Track, with DOI 10.52202/085713-3520.

provenance_corrections.reason: The discovery index changed this existing record's provenance from a conference DBLP entry to an arXiv DBLP entry. A preprint entry alone does not substantiate conference acceptance. The formal NeurIPS proceedings were separately verified and are now stored as stable first-party provenance. The paper's identity, year, reading link, source abstract and pending taxonomy-review state are preserved; this is not a new paper or a completed semantic review.

ledger_adjustment: NeurIPS new_records is reduced from 95 to 94 after the existing HiMaCon record is promoted to a seed, so the final non-seed merge total plus seeds reconciles to 4364. Actual harvest matched_records and classified_records remain unchanged.
limitations: This review verifies formal-publication provenance for the one new conference entry and the one regressed provenance link; it is not an independent acceptance audit of every conference record.
The RSS record's supplied abstract is truncated. It is not silently rewritten from another source or represented as a complete abstract.
The old 77 seeds and their historical verification dates remain unchanged; only the newly verified HiMaCon provenance is dated 2026-10-30.
An original publication year, a source-observation snapshot and a document synchronization date are distinct. Earlier dated refresh receipts remain immutable.
